title: Admin
lead: Site-wide settings and users. What you change here applies to the whole site, not to your own settings; every change is logged.
denied: Only an admin can open this page.
tabs.label: Admin sections
reset_title: Clear the value set here and use the environment variable or the default
src_title: Where the current value comes from: this page first, then the environment variable, then the default
order_note: Order: each person's own setting → their plan's default → the site setting (this page → environment variable → default).
plan_title: This plan's own default; leave empty to use the site value
group.sources_lead: Switch a source off in one click when something goes wrong: the scheduler stops running it, users see it as paused in their settings, and imported activities stay.
group.cooldown_lead: How long the same person waits before pressing again. The site value is the free plan's; the subscriber plan's default is shorter. The owner and admins are not limited. The defaults are estimates.
group.ratelimit_lead: At most this many requests per minute for each signed-in person; beyond it: "too many requests". Static files don't count; the owner and admins are not limited. The defaults are estimates.
source.tripped: Paused automatically: several accounts were blocked in a short time
source.confirm_off: Switch off “{name}”? Syncing from this source pauses for every user.
item.sync.history_days: History fetched on the first sync (days)
item.sync.history_days.help: How many days back a new connection's first back-fill goes; 0 = everything (from 2020-01-01). Accounts already synced are not affected.
item.sync.night_start.help: The free plan syncs once a night, spread over the window after this time.
item.sync.night_span_min.help: Each person's sync time is spread over this window by account, so they don't all start at once.
item.members.max_users.help: Sign-up stops at this many accounts and new people go on the waitlist. Admins and disabled accounts count.
item.quota.free.charts.help: Chart dashboards a person can open per day.
item.quota.free.calc: Free plan: calculator runs per month
item.coros.rate_per_s.help: The whole server's speed limit for COROS calls.
item.archive.retention_years.help: Used for people who haven't chosen; each person can still change their own in Settings.
item.defaults.region.help: The region for a new user until their data shows where they are.
item.notice.zh.help: Shown at the top of every page; users can close it. Leave empty for none.
item.notice.en.help: Shown in the English interface; when empty, the Chinese one is shown.
item.cooldown.sync: Sync now (each source on its own)
item.cooldown.racepower_inputs.help: While cooling down the cached result is used; no error is shown.
item.cooldown.surface: Calculator › Look up the surface again
item.ratelimit.heavy_per_min: Heavy computations per person per minute
item.ratelimit.heavy_per_min.help: The race calculator, workout equivalence and other heavy computations are limited on top.
err.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You can't disable yourself or the admin
err.NOT_WAITING: This person has already been let in
err.OWNER_PLAN: The admin account has no plan
accounts_off: This site doesn't have multi-user sign-in on; you are its only user. User management and the waitlist fill in once sign-up is open.
act.confirm_disable: Disable {who}? They are signed out at once; no data is deleted.
role.site_owner_note: The primary admin is always an admin and can't be deleted or demoted
act.confirm_admin: Make {who} an admin? They can change site settings and manage users, including deleting accounts.
act.delete_mismatch: That didn't match; nothing was deleted
act.deleting: Deleting… (may take up to a minute)
err.LAST_ADMIN: At least one admin must remain
err.OWNER_ROLE: The primary admin is always an admin
err.OWNER_PROTECTED: The primary admin's account can't be deleted
err.SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE: Their subscription is still being charged and can't be cancelled automatically, so nothing was deleted; cancel it at the payment service first
err.BILLING_UPSTREAM: The payment service didn't answer and the subscription isn't cancelled yet, so nothing was deleted; try again later
err.GOOGLE_INCOMPLETE: The server's environment has no value to fall back on: clearing this would stop everyone signing in. To change it, enter the new value instead
google.lead: The Google OAuth client ID and secret used to sign in. Values here take precedence over the server's environment variables; clear them to go back to the environment. Changes apply from the next sign-in, no restart needed.
google.redirect: In the Google Cloud Console OAuth client, the authorised redirect URI is:
google.id_help: Looks like 1234-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com. It isn't a secret (it appears in the sign-in address), so it is shown.
google.secret_help: Stored encrypted. Once set, only "Set" is shown, never the value. To change it, enter the new one.
google.secret_set_ph: Set (fill in only to change it)
google.unreadable: The stored secret can't be opened with the current server key, so the environment's is in use; enter it again.
google.note_signin: Only the ID and secret are changed here; whether sign-in is on, the primary admin's Google account and the site address stay in the server settings.
google.note_owner: Sign-in isn't on for this site, so these values are used once it is turned on; the server's environment then doesn't need a Google client of its own.
google.saved: Saved; the next sign-in uses the new values
audit.google.secret_cleared: Google client secret cleared (environment in use)
wait.admit_title: Create the account now (past the cap); they sign in with the same Google account and accept the terms
wait.confirm_admit: Let {email} in? The account is created even past the cap.
wait.admitted_ok: Let in: the account is ready
err.BAD_NAME: Enter a name, at most 40 characters
err.BAD_WEEKS: Pick the weeks from the list
err.BAD_LEVEL: Pick the level from the list
err.NOT_ADMIN_MADE: Only test accounts made here have one-time sign-in links; a marked account signs in its own way
err.MOCK_RUNNING: The made-up data is still being built; wait for it
err.SIGNIN_OFF: Sign-in is not on for this site, so one-time sign-in links are not needed
err.CANNOT_MARK_SELF: You can't mark yourself or the admin as a test account
err.ADMIN_MADE: A test account made here can't be unmarked; delete it when you no longer need it
err.NOT_TEST: Only test accounts can be deleted here
err.SYNC_BUSY: This account is syncing; try again in a moment
tests.new.lead: No real email and no mail sent. Sign in with a one-time link in a private window or another browser to be several people at once (a coach and their students, for example).
tests.new.name: Name
tests.new.note: Test accounts don't count toward the member cap, stay out of the statistics and the de-identified data pool, can't pay and can't connect any real sync platform; regular users never see them. With more than one, a number is added to the name.
tests.list.lead: A one-time sign-in link works for {min} minutes and only once. Deleting a test account ends its sign-ins and links too; your own sign-in is not affected.
tests.list.lead_owner: Sign-in is not on for this site: you can make test accounts and their data, but there are no one-time sign-in links.
tests.link_note: Works until {time}, once only. Open it in a private window, another browser or a phone; this link is not shown again.
tests.confirm_delete: Delete the test account “{who}” and all its data? Its sign-ins end at once.
audit.test.link: Sign-in link made for test account {key}
